note: Archive of the former symbolic reward vocabulary and assignments in this collection. These are not offers by sponsors, nor original Scottish Book awards.

references.name: R. Daniel Mauldin (ed.), The Scottish Book, 2nd ed. (Springer, 2015)
University of St Andrews, MacTutor, Stanisław Mazur

historical_vocabulary.label: A small black coffee
historical_vocabulary.historical_note: A small black coffee appears among the rewards specified by Hugo Steinhaus for Problem 152.

historical_vocabulary.label: One small beer
historical_vocabulary.historical_note: Small beer was a recorded Scottish Book prize, including one outcome of Problem 152.

historical_vocabulary.label: Five small beers
historical_vocabulary.historical_note: Five small beers appear among the historical Scottish Book prizes.

historical_vocabulary.label: A bottle of wine
historical_vocabulary.historical_note: A bottle of wine was offered for several Scottish Book problems, including Problem 6.

historical_vocabulary.label: A bottle of whisky of positive measure
historical_vocabulary.historical_note: The whisky prize is mentioned in the preface of Mauldin's edition.

historical_vocabulary.label: One hundred grams of caviar
historical_vocabulary.historical_note: Hugo Steinhaus's Problem 152 offered caviar for an explicit numerical determination.

historical_vocabulary.label: One kilogram of bacon
historical_vocabulary.historical_note: One kilogram of bacon is among the prizes in the Scottish Book.

historical_vocabulary.label: A live goose
historical_vocabulary.historical_note: Stanisław Mazur offered a live goose for Problem 153, awarded to Per Enflo in 1972.

rewards.condition: A proof of bounded prime-sum deficit, or an unbounded sequence of deficits.
A classification of four-cycle-switch components for all prime-sum perfect matchings.
A proof of matching-packing equality for every order, or a counterexample.
An asymptotic determination of the connectivity threshold for one-mark Sidon exchanges.
A necessary and sufficient criterion for connected coprime-permutation switch graphs.
The sharp leading constant in the maximum size of a prime-difference-free Sidon set.
A proof or disproof of eventual attainment of the parity upper bound for coprime paths.
A specified non-tautological expansion of the arithmetic connectivity threshold with a proved error term.
A proof that two prime sums suffice for every positive integer n, or an explicit counterexample.
An independently checked Lean formalization of the exact coprime-adjacency theorem.
A rigorous threshold law for perfect matchings in the random sum-diagonal graph model.
A sharp connectivity threshold for the four-cycle reconfiguration graph under arithmetic thinning.
A sequence of site probabilities where Sidon configurations exist with high probability but the exchange graph is disconnected with high probability.
A proof or disproof that the specified Cayley-sum flag-complex homology thresholds match the independent-edge model.
A general proof of four-class odd-area flip connectivity, or a finite counterexample.
A proof of eventual vanishing for each fixed homological degree, or an infinite nonvanishing family.
Existence or nonexistence of the normalized longest-chain limit for a fixed site density strictly between zero and one.
The least uniform exchange size connecting every feasible conserved-XOR basis fiber.
A universal bound on simultaneous replacements in optimal no-three-in-line configurations, or a proof of unboundedness.
An explicit limiting distribution for random p-adic Hankel cokernels, or a proof that it does not exist.
An exact probability for a previously untreated three-generator higher-exponent cokernel class.
An explicit limiting Sylow-group distribution for the correlated Cayley-sum sandpile model.
A proved nontrivial homology transition regime for the random unimodular triangle complex.
A sharp threshold for full rank of the random prime-incidence matrix.
The first-order asymptotics of the zero-forcing number of the divisor comparability graph.
A proof or disproof of the cyclic analogue of the known adjacent-lcm bottleneck asymptotic.
A proof that prime-sum four-cycles span the binary cycle space in all orders, or a counterexample.
A classification of irreducible components and a sharp mixing-time estimate on a specified nontrivial component.
A nondegenerate fluctuation law for the random Euler characteristic after explicit centering and scaling.
A universal bounded-size exchange theorem for nontrivial prime-sum X-ray fibers, or counterexamples with unbounded exchange size.
A perfect double-prime matching for every even order at least eight, or an exceptional order.
A sharp asymptotic for the maximum size of a pairwise-coprime Sidon subset of an initial interval.
A proof of eventual diameter seven in prime-sum bipartite graphs, or infinitely many failures.
A proof that three prime sums always connect the graph on an initial interval, or a counterexample.
A construction using four prime sums for every odd order at least seven, or an exceptional order.
An asymptotically optimal Sidon and divisibility-antichain coloring, or a larger lower bound.
The critical scale and limiting law for the first nonempty two-core in a random Schur hypergraph.
The maximal-order growth of the induced-cycle prime-gap deficit.
A sharpened asymptotic error term for the logarithm of the coprime-graph induced-matching number.
A proof that prime-product-plus-one pairings exist for every n at least one, or an infinite obstruction family.
Existence and exact value of the limiting coprime-matching local resilience.
A limiting constant for the second-order gap between unrestricted and squarefree random divisibility chains.
Hamiltonian paths in every one-carry graph of dimension at least four, or an infinite obstruction family.
A sharp asymptotic for the largest component of the prime-denominator Farey graph.
The optimal order of the error in the squarefree-displacement permanent asymptotic.
A complete construction of almost-distinct-product additive complete mappings for all primes at least five, or a counterexample.
A constant-factor square-root lower bound for XOR-Sidon sets of primes in all sufficiently large dyadic intervals.
An improvement of the current 1/m factor in the dyadic XOR-Sidon lower bound.
A full-dimensional compact perfect simultaneous four-point Sidon set, or a proof that none exists.
A proved limit and explicit characterization of the rank density for every fixed retention probability.
A proof or counterexample to the exact dyadic prime-Hamming cube coloring formula.
